caption:
Can a loan recovery agent call you at 10 pm?

No. Since August 2022, RBI instructions say lenders and their recovery agents can't call about overdue loans before 8 am or after 7 pm.
Threats, harassment, anonymous or threatening calls and misleading claims are also not allowed.
Getting such calls? Note the time and number, complain to the lender in writing, then go to the RBI ombudsman.
